To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the audit firms that have a high level of contact with clients and have a long-term relationship with them have a higher level of audit quality in terms of the perception of their clients.
the quality of the audit service in the Czech Republic is perceived to be satisfactory by the majority of respondents.

(1) the majority of respondents to the questionnaire were happy with the quality of the audit service provided to them; and (2) the most important factors that influence perceptions of audit quality were the personal contact between the auditor and the client and how long the client has been using the services of the particular audit firm.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the perceptions of audit quality held by preparers of financial statements and the factors that may affect those perceptions.
the factors affecting the assessment of the quality of a company's auditors.
the quality of audit in the Czech republic and its perception by Czech companies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the audit firms operating in the Czech Republic are providing a satisfactory level of audit quality to their clients.
there is no significant relationship between the name of a particular audit firm and the quality of audit services provided.
the Czech audit market is not dominated by one audit firm.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the quality of audit services is perceived by most respondents to be good.
the Czech Republic has a well-established audit market with a high degree of satisfaction with the audit services.
the Czech audit profession is developing well.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the audit firms that have been operating in the Czech Republic for the longest time are the ones that are most likely to be perceived as having the highest quality audit.
the Czech auditing market is still in its formative stage.

the audit profession has a long way to go to convince the business community that it is an effective and independent profession in the Czech Republic and that it is able to provide high quality audits.
